title: Asian Toddler Girl with Doll Buggy, 1957 Christmas Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Christmas Eve. 1957 Shirley Wada + Connie her doll, The doll buggy she got for Christmas. 473
description: A mid-century black-and-white indoor snapshot photo taken on Christmas Eve 1957, depicting young Shirley Wada posing behind a toy doll buggy containing her doll, Connie. She is dressed in a charming dress with ruffled shoulders and rick-rack detailing. Handwritten notes on the reverse document the holiday occasion and subjects.
